referenceTaskObservation.note: The reference task has one offer event and no submitted evidence events, so this fixture uses the same accepted Task Node review packet shape with sample evidence.

task.title: Create Orc Review Formatter Submission Artifacts
task.summary: Build the review-formatting layer between a submitted Network Task evidence packet and a later Orc review result. Produce a runnable script, sample input, generated prompt, parsed JSON, and Discord-ready summary.
task.description: Task Node needs the working step between submitted network-task evidence and an Orc review result. This fixture models the public packet fields consumed by the formatter: task metadata, public status packet, submission evidence refs, reward refs, evaluation packet, and timeline.

submissions.summary: Submitted the formatter script and generated proof artifacts.

artifacts.notes: Runnable Node script that converts a Task Node evidence packet into an Orc prompt and parses the Orc response into the five-field JSON contract.
Contains sample input packet, generated prompt, sample Orc response, parsed JSON output, and Discord-ready summary.

verification.request: Show the script file, a sample evidence packet, the generated Orc review prompt, the resulting JSON output, and a short Discord-ready summary.
verification.response: The formatter was run locally against this sample packet and sample Orc response. It produced generated_review_prompt.md, review_output.json, and discord_summary.md.

outcome.reason: The sample demonstrates the requested evidence packet to prompt to parsed JSON flow end to end.

evaluationPackets.summary: Evidence includes a runnable formatter script, sample input, generated prompt, parsed output JSON, and Discord-ready summary.
evaluationPackets.recommendation: Archive the artifacts and keep the review as a formatting-layer demonstration.
